Name: CognyteLuminar
Author: Cognyte
Description:
The [Cognyte Luminar](https://www.cognyte.com/) solution for Microsoft Sentinel ingests Luminar threat intelligence from the IOCs and Cyber Feeds collections as STIX 2.1 indicators, threat actors, identities and relationships. Indicators from Cyber Feeds are enriched with context from Luminar reports, and expired indicators are skipped. The data lands in the ThreatIntelIndicators and ThreatIntelObjects tables for use by threat intelligence analytics rules, hunting and investigation.

**Underlying Microsoft Technologies used:**

This solution takes a dependency on the following technologies, and some of these dependencies either may be in [Preview](https://azure.microsoft.com/support/legal/preview-supplemental-terms/) state or might result in additional ingestion or operational costs:

a. [Microsoft Sentinel threat intelligence upload API](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/sentinel/stix-objects-api)

b. [Azure Functions](https://azure.microsoft.com/services/functions/#overview)
